# hpe_morpheus_provisioning_license (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_provisioning_license" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_provisioning_license" "example" {
  name = "Example name"
}
```
